items.title: Yum Brands Says It’s Moving Quickly to Address Issues From Cyclospora Outbreak
items.summary: Yum Brands said its teams are acting quickly and transparently to address current issues associated with the multistate cyclospora outbreak that has been linked to iceberg lettuce served at some of its Taco Bell locations.

items.title: Yum Brands (YUM) Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates
items.summary: Yum (YUM) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.89% and -0.55%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Cyclospora outbreak clouds strong earnings for Taco Bell’s parent company
items.summary: Taco Bell’s parent company, Yum Brands, reported robust sales and profit in the second quarter, surpassing Wall Street’s expectations by several measures. But the earnings cover the April-June quarter, or the three months before a cyclospora outbreak plunged the company’s most important brand into a food-safety crisis.

items.title: Yum Brands shares up in premarket trade on Q2 profit beat, Pizza Hut sale
items.summary: Investing.com -- Yum Brands shares rose in premarket trading on Thursday after the KFC and Taco Bell owner reported second-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.62 per share, beating the analyst consensus average of $1.58, helped by robust same-store sales and restaurant-level margin performance, according to Chief Executive Chris Turner.

items.title: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) Reports Q2 CY2026 In Line With Expectations
items.summary: Fast-food company Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 12.2% year on year to $2.17 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.62 per share was 3.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Yum Brands Q2 2026 earnings: Taco Bell cyclospora outbreak
items.summary: The restaurant company posted adjusted EPS of $1.62, topping estimates, but its results predate the foodborne illness crisis now hitting Taco Bell traffic

items.title: Yum! Brands Beats Earnings Expectations. No Word on Cyclosporiasis Outbreak.
items.summary: Yum! Brands second-quarter earnings top Wall Street expectations as Taco Bell sales rise even as a cyclosporiasis outbreak dominates investor focus.

items.title: Taco Bell’s Lettuce Trouble Serves Up A Tough Test For Yum! Brands Ahead Of Q2 Earnings
items.summary: Yum! Brands is facing investor concerns as Taco Bell’s lettuce-related cyclospora outbreak affects customer visits ahead of its Q2 earnings report.
